feed.title: AI Science Tracker: additions and source checks

entry.title: GPT-6 Astra assists a gauge-invariant lattice chiral-fermion measure construction
entry.summary: Nathaniel Craig proposes a smooth, exponentially local, gauge-invariant fermion measure on admissible four-dimensional lattices, with restrictions covering the Standard Model gauge groups. GPT-6 Astra helped develop the refinement construction and led the detailed proof. The supplementary report… (Discovery - University of California, Santa Barbara; OpenAI; announced 2026-10-06)

entry.title: ERTransformer-generated TCR candidates activate T cells in defined receptor contexts
entry.summary: ERTransformer generated epitope-conditioned TCR β-chain CDR3 candidates. Flow-cytometry experiments found selected artificial TCRs induced activation comparable to or greater than natural controls in defined TCR/pMHC contexts. This represents the September 2026 journal report; an ERTransformer… (Discovery - Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab; City University of Hong Kong; The University of Hong Kong; Xijing Hospital of Digestive Diseases; Harvard Medical School, Harvard University; Monash University; announced 2026-09-02)

entry.title: Spatial-DC maps a candidate fibroblast–cancer signaling interaction in pancreatic tumors
entry.summary: Spatial-DC reconstructed cell-type-resolved spatial proteomes and suggested COL8A1–ITGA2 communication between cancer-associated fibroblasts and pancreatic cancer cells. Multiplexed immunohistochemistry supported the spatial predictions; human protein co-expression was associated with survival.… (Discovery - Southern University of Science and Technology; Tencent AI for Life Sciences Laboratory; announced 2026-05-27)

entry.title: ORI engineers active lysozymes, heat-tolerant chitinases and dual-activity enzymes
entry.summary: Tencent researchers used ontology-conditioned generation and experimental feedback to engineer enzymes. In the reported assays, lysozyme TX-RL15 exceeded the earlier TX-L6 design by 66-fold and hen egg-white lysozyme by over two orders of magnitude. Chitinase TX-SC2 retained activity after… (Discovery - Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab; announced 2026-03-19)

entry.title: tFold designs binding antibodies against four defined antigens
entry.summary: Tencent researchers generated antibodies against influenza hemagglutinin, PD-1, PD-L1 and SARS-CoV-2 RBD, followed by phage-display screening and SPR characterization. Anti-SC2RBD-H330 showed neutralization IC50 of 0.42 nM. Screening remained extensive, and some confident epitope predictions… (Discovery - Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab; announced 2025-12-10)

entry.title: HuDiff humanizes antibodies and nanobodies while retaining measured binding
entry.summary: HuDiff generated humanized variants of a murine SARS-CoV-2 RBD antibody and two alpaca nanobodies. Bio-layer interferometry measured 0.15 nM affinity for the best humanized antibody versus 0.12 nM for its parent; a humanized nanobody measured 2.52 nM versus 5.47 nM. The journal abstract also… (Discovery - School of Basic Medical Sciences, Lanzhou University; Tencent AI Lab; Fudan University; Peking University; announced 2025-10-01)

entry.title: AI-assisted macaque claustrum atlas links cell types with projection zones
entry.summary: Learned segmentation and Spatial-ID annotation helped connect macaque claustral cell-type distributions with four projection zones identified through tracer experiments. Different glutamatergic compositions preferentially connected to different brain regions. This is the April 3, 2025 journal… (Discovery - Chinese Academy of Sciences; Stem Cell and Brain Research Institute, Inserm; BGI-Research; Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab; announced 2025-04-03)

entry.title: Machine-learning-assisted taxonomy identifies Limnognathia desmeti
entry.summary: Learned analyses of transcriptomic data contributed to an integrative description of Limnognathia desmeti from the Crozet Islands, the second species described in Micrognathozoa. Phylogenomic and molecular evidence also contributed; machine learning alone did not establish the species. Greenland… (Discovery - University of Copenhagen; University of Barcelona; Natural History Museum, London; announced 2025-02-19)

entry.title: Robotic learning identifies nine polyoxometalate-based frameworks
entry.summary: A robot and an XGBoost classifier guided crystallization experiments that produced nine reported polyoxometalate-scaffolding metal-organic frameworks. Researchers defined the chemistry and performed structural and electrochemical characterization. The measured electron-transfer behavior does not… (Discovery - University of Glasgow; announced 2024-10-09)

entry.title: AI-assisted cerebellar atlases reveal primate-specific cellular organization
entry.summary: Deep-learning segmentation and spatial annotation supported cerebellar atlases of macaques, marmosets and mice, revealing primate-specific cell subtypes and regional gene-expression differences. Transcriptomic gradients corresponded with awake functional-connectivity patterns. This represents the… (Discovery - BGI-Research; Chinese Academy of Sciences; Erasmus MC; Tencent AI Lab; announced 2024-09-27)

entry.title: COSTAR predicts drug activity tested in glioblastoma samples
entry.summary: A learned drug-target connectivity signature selected 23 predicted hits and 25 negatives for testing in four glioblastoma patient samples. Ex-vivo measurements agreed with predictions at a reported mean ROC AUC of 0.94. The small validation establishes a bounded drug-activity prediction result… (Discovery - ETH Zurich; University Hospital Zurich; University of Zurich; announced 2024-09-20)

entry.title: Human-guided active learning improves nickel-cobalt methanation tests
entry.summary: A human-in-the-loop model selected nickel-cobalt catalysts and reaction settings for a 48-test laboratory campaign. Further selected experiments improved methane space-time yield by nearly 50% over the previous maximum in that dataset. Extrapolation remained harder than interpolation. This is a… (Discovery - EPFL; Empa; Ghent University; announced 2024-09-10)

entry.title: Learned call analysis identifies receiver-specific marmoset vocal patterns
entry.summary: Classifiers identified receiver-related structure in calls from ten captive marmosets. Playback experiments also found stronger responses to calls originally directed at the listener. The authors interpret these patterns as vocal labels; a later commentary disputes whether the evidence establishes… (Discovery - Hebrew University of Jerusalem; announced 2024-08-29)

entry.title: Bayesian optimization improves printed BiSbTe thermoelectrics
entry.summary: Learned models guided ink formulation and printing settings for known BiSbTe-based material. The resulting printed samples reached a reported room-temperature zT of 1.3. This is an experimental processing result, rather than discovery of a new chemical composition or demonstrated deployed-device… (Discovery - University of Notre Dame; Marquette University; announced 2024-07-01)

entry.title: Simulation-trained inference maps accreted stellar mass in nearby galaxies
entry.summary: A model trained on simulated galaxy observations inferred accreted stellar fractions in nearby MaNGA galaxies. Predictions suggest in-situ formation dominates most of the studied mass range, while accreted fractions rise in the most massive systems and vary with galaxy characteristics. These are… (Discovery - Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias; University of La Laguna; Max Planck Institute for Astronomy; announced 2024-06-28)

entry.title: Bayesian search identifies organic metallophotocatalyst formulations
entry.summary: Gaussian-process models and chemist decisions guided synthesis and testing of organic photocatalysts for a specified cross-coupling reaction. A catalyst search reached 67% yield before reaction-condition optimization. This establishes a bounded formulation result for the studied reaction, not… (Discovery - Zhejiang Normal University; University of Liverpool; University of Birmingham; IBM Research; announced 2024-06-11)

entry.title: LAISS-assisted review reclassifies anomalous ZTF transients
entry.summary: Expert review of 455 previously observed transients changed 16 normal labels to anomalous; the random-forest model flagged 11 of these. Spectra, light curves and host context supported the reclassifications. This is a retrospective study-level result rather than a count of newly observed events or… (Discovery - University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Pacific Northwest National Laboratory; announced 2024-04-01)

entry.title: Active learning identifies experimentally improved ammonia catalysts
entry.summary: Literature-trained models and iterative experimental feedback guided a predetermined ammonia-catalyst search. Selected formulations exceeded many reported comparator activities in the authors' laboratory measurements. Initial literature-only predictions were insufficient, making feedback… (Discovery - University of South Carolina; announced 2024-01-02)

entry.title: AI-assisted hippocampal atlas maps Alzheimer-associated cellular changes around amyloid plaques
entry.summary: In a six-donor postmortem hippocampal study, neural cell segmentation and Spatial-ID annotation helped map Alzheimer-associated cell distributions and gene-expression changes. Immunofluorescence supported the inferred accumulation patterns of microglia and astrocytes around amyloid-beta plaques.… (Discovery - Zhejiang University; BGI Research; Tencent AI Lab; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; announced 2023-12-07)

entry.title: Neural active learning guides stronger bone-scaffold architectures
entry.summary: Learned architecture models and finite-element simulations guided fabrication of scaffold subunits. A larger scaffold assembled through human adaptation of the learned structures showed about 20% greater load-bearing capacity than the uniform comparator. This is a mechanical bench-test result, not… (Discovery - Tsinghua University; Peking University; Max Planck Institute for Iron Research; announced 2023-10-19)

entry.title: BTSbot workflow automatically confirms and classifies SN 2023tyk
entry.summary: BTSbot selected SN 2023tyk from ZTF alerts and requested robotic spectroscopy; SNIascore supplied its Type Ia classification. The integrated workflow publicly reported the result without human intervention in those steps. This is one transient result, not a new supernova class or a claim that… (Discovery - Northwestern University; California Institute of Technology; announced 2023-10-11)

entry.title: AI-assisted protein-family analysis identifies a tested toxin-antitoxin superfamily
entry.summary: AI-predicted structural information helped researchers prioritize previously poorly characterized protein families. Experiments supported a translation-targeting toxin-antitoxin superfamily, TumE–TumA. This is one tested family-level result; the broader proposed families and predicted fold are not… (Discovery - University of Basel; SIB Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics; announced 2023-09-13)

entry.title: AI-assisted macaque cortex atlas reveals regional cell-type organization
entry.summary: AI-assisted segmentation and Spatial-ID annotation helped map 264 transcriptome-defined cell types across the macaque cortex. Regional cell-type composition tracked cortical hierarchy, and cross-species comparisons identified primate-specific types enriched in layer 4. This is the July 12, 2023… (Discovery - Chinese Academy of Sciences; BGI-Research; Tencent AI Lab; announced 2023-07-12)

entry.title: Organ-specific learned networks prioritize tested seed-lipid regulators
entry.summary: Learned organ classification enabled regulatory-network inference that nominated seed-lipid regulators for genetic and physiological testing in Arabidopsis. The result was public in a June 2023 preprint before the April 2024 journal article. Candidate counts differ between versions, so the entry… (Discovery - Purdue University; announced 2023-06-18)

entry.title: Active learning maps wind-tunnel terrain equivalence
entry.summary: A learned surrogate selected automated wind-tunnel experiments that mapped terrain configurations with similar second-order wind statistics. Different terrain shapes could meet the study's equivalence criterion. This does not imply identical full turbulence fields or equal structural safety… (Discovery - Johns Hopkins University; announced 2023-05-24)

entry.title: EmbryoNet links statins to FGF-like zebrafish developmental effects
entry.summary: A learned embryo-image classifier flagged statin-treated zebrafish as resembling reduced FGF signaling. Follow-up morphology and pERK measurements supported the developmental-pathway association. The mechanism remains proposed, and the zebrafish assays do not establish effects in human pregnancy… (Discovery - University of Konstanz; Friedrich Miescher Laboratory of the Max Planck Society; announced 2023-05-08)

entry.title: Learned promoter models identify human-specific transcription motifs
entry.summary: Models trained on promoter activity measurements helped characterize a human-specific downstream promoter variant and select synthetic motifs with species-specific activity. In-vitro transcription assays tested the predicted preferences with human and Drosophila extracts. These are gene-regulation… (Discovery - University of California San Diego; announced 2023-04-25)

entry.title: Learned community models prioritize a tested bacterial colonization inhibitor
entry.summary: Models trained on community composition helped identify Enterococcus faecalis as an inhibitor of Enterococcus faecium colonization in human stool-derived laboratory communities. Follow-up supported the predicted interaction under the tested conditions. The result was public in an April 2023… (Discovery - Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Brigham and Women's Hospital; Harvard Medical School; announced 2023-04-21)

entry.title: ExoGRU-guided experiments support RBM24 involvement in small-RNA secretion
entry.summary: A recurrent model of RNA-sequence features helped nominate RNA-binding proteins involved in secretion. Perturbation and binding experiments supported RBM24 involvement in the tested cell system, alongside previously implicated factors. This mechanism study was public in an April 2023 preprint… (Discovery - University of California, San Francisco; Sharif University of Technology; McGill University; announced 2023-04-06)

entry.title: Acoustic learning maps spider-monkey associations with forest disturbance
entry.summary: A learned call detector, manual confirmation and occupancy modeling analyzed recordings from 341 Costa Rican sites. In this sample, Geoffroy's spider monkey was detected only above 80% forest cover and away from nearby primary paved roads. These are regional observational associations, not causal… (Discovery - Imperial College London; Osa Conservation; announced 2023-03-15)

entry.title: Learned morphology guides targeted isolation of gut bacteria
entry.summary: A learned morphology model selected likely target genera for robotic isolation, followed by sequencing to confirm cultured organisms. This supports a bounded, experimentally tested recovery result. The platform's broader diversity-selection component uses feature distances and is not itself… (Discovery - Columbia University; announced 2023-02-20)

entry.title: Support-vector regression selects more selective tetrahydropyran catalysts
entry.summary: Models of catalyst fragments and reaction settings selected catalysts for asymmetric tetrahydropyran synthesis. A tested catalyst reached an enantiomeric ratio of 91.5:8.5, above the training examples' maximum of 82:18. The result improves a known catalyst class for a focused reaction; it does not… (Discovery - Hokkaido University; Max Planck Institute for Coal Research; University of Strasbourg; announced 2023-01-23)

entry.title: Deep-learning control links single-cell expression to growth responses
entry.summary: A learned predictive controller enabled high-throughput measurements linking gene-expression patterns with functional outcomes in individual engineered bacterial cells. The study exposed heterogeneous growth responses under antibiotic challenge. The original result was public in the October 2022… (Discovery - Boston University; announced 2022-10-31)

entry.title: FLEET-guided observing campaign classifies superluminous supernovae
entry.summary: FLEET used transient light curves and host-galaxy features to prioritize telescope follow-up. Its first two-year campaign spectroscopically classified 21 superluminous supernovae. This is one campaign-level result, not 21 separately counted discoveries or proof that FLEET first detected every… (Discovery - Space Telescope Science Institute; Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian; announced 2022-10-19)

entry.title: Generative learning selects experimentally active EGFR inhibitor analogs
entry.summary: A recurrent generative model refined by reinforcement learning selected compounds for an EGFR enzyme assay. Four of 15 predicted-active compounds were active, including two with nanomolar inhibition; five predicted-inactive controls were inactive. The experimentally tested compounds were… (Discovery - Carnegie Mellon University; University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; Enamine; announced 2022-10-18)

entry.title: Active learning improves a cell-free carbon-fixation cycle
entry.summary: An ensemble learned from experimental feedback to select compositions for an engineered carbon-fixation cycle. Laboratory measurements supported improved glycolate production compared with the study's reference cycle. This is an in-vitro pathway result, not carbon capture by living organisms or a… (Discovery - Max Planck Institute for Terrestrial Microbiology; announced 2022-07-05)

entry.title: Learned cluster expansion guides an acidic oxygen-evolution catalyst
entry.summary: A fitted energy model and quantum-inspired optimizer selected a mixed-oxide catalyst family for laboratory testing. The study reports a Ru-Cr-Mn-Sb oxide catalyst with higher ruthenium-normalized activity than its RuO2 comparator and sustained operation in the tested setup. This is one bounded… (Discovery - University of Toronto; Harvard University; Fujitsu Consulting (Canada); announced 2022-05-18)

entry.title: Random-forest selection links a food compound to COX-1 inhibition
entry.summary: A random-forest model prioritized 5-methoxysalicylic acid for a COX-1 enzyme assay. It showed about 40% inhibition at 100 micromolar, whereas a higher-ranked single-fingerprint comparator did not inhibit at that concentration. This is a modest in-vitro target result, not evidence of dietary… (Discovery - European Molecular Biology Laboratory; University of Cambridge; announced 2022-04-25)

entry.title: Machine-guided microscopy characterizes an atypical ataxia presentation
entry.summary: Unsupervised image analysis detected cellular patterns not apparent by inspection in an investigation of one family with an atypical ataxia presentation. Additional cell experiments found altered ataxin-7 behavior and mitochondrial bioenergetic deficits. The proposed combined role of ATXN7 and… (Discovery - McMaster University; University of British Columbia; University of Toronto; University of Pittsburgh; announced 2022-04-14)

entry.title: Learned phase models identify synergistic photoanode mixtures
entry.summary: Learning from measured diffraction and photocurrent data identified Bi-Cu-V oxide phase mixtures whose photoactivity exceeded an additive non-interacting-phase model. BiVO4-like phases showed beneficial associations with copper-vanadate phases. This is an experimentally grounded… (Discovery - California Institute of Technology; Cornell University; announced 2022-04-05)
